plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).

courses.title: Core Curriculum and/or Major (A.A.S. degree in-block transferred courses)
courses.choice_note: A maximum of 66 semester credit hours are transferable. Additional hours may be needed to meet the total 122 SCH requirement. Students may transfer up to 36 SCH of WECM coursework from their A.A.S. degree. For more detailed information concerning General Education, Major, requirements, and transferable courses, please contact the Sam Center.
